decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 00657/61/P7 (13/05/2015)

Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, full specifications and fixing details of the external staircase and pedestrian gate to 61 Kew Bridge Station shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to the commencement of development.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details approved.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1213-01-120-S0-P1, 1213-01-121-S0-P1, 1213-01-122-S0- P1, 1213-01-123-S0-P1. Received 04/12/15
1213-0128-SO-P3, 1213-01-127-S0-P2, 1213-01-124-SO-P2, Received 23/12/15
1213-01-125-S0-P5, 1213-01-126-S0-P4  Received 24/02/16) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Variation of condition 2 to provide amendments to the external staircase and condition 3 approved plans of planning permission 00657/61/P7 dated 13/05/2015 for change of use and alterations to the building to provide commercial uses on the lower ground and ground floors together with a 3-bedroom apartment on the top floor.  Creation of external stairs and side entrance at upper ground floor, changing of door to window in rear, installation of access gate to side, internal alterations to second floor.
